ketamine unicycle
I have used many drugs for years and been a regular pot smoker, I recently quit pot due to a bad chest and general lethargy.
This was probably the first time I had k without pot, and it seemed clearer.
I have had k many times, but now try to do it less freqently.
In the past I have met an entity on a high dose.
Looked like:    1  /
-- 1 /--
1/
-------
---------
-----------
---------
-------
In energy bands of impossible colours it approched then turned and the lines ran on to infinity.  I felt a presence and it gave me a message.
I have played ketamin pool, each time one pot a ball one have a line of k , the game takes a long time and is very amusing, I always beat my friend due to a high tolerence, which I've had since I bought a bottle.-I can no longer get such profound K holes.
We were wondering if anyone else had tried,My friend wrote a poem something like;
Have you ever felt so cool,
As you played a game of Ketamin pool,
Have you ever felt so nice ,
Have you ever played ketamin pool twice.
Anyway the other night I scored a couple of grams of K and shared this between friends, I was amazed at my ability to ride a unicycle around the streets of
my city at night, I even tried going down steps and mannaged two without falling off, at this time I was hallucinating with double vision and could not walk in a streight line. Strange.
It seems that K effects co-ordination, but not so much balance.
Maybee
